author: Hank Green
description:
The Sun is more than 99% of the mass of the solar system. The sun is the center of the solar system. The Sun without the /rest/ of the solar system would be extremely boring. 

By far the most interesting thing about the sun is that it is part of a system of worlds, and this has become pretty obviously true to me about Saturn, Jupiter, and to some extent Uranus and Neptune. 

If we skip the worlds that orbit these giants, we are missing the most interesting part of the story.
